messages.text:
The bond of football fans
is stronger than any tackle!{be01}

Hawk: The bond between you and
your Pokémon is strong, too!{be01}
Dar: This feeling will go well past
the goal line...

Our bond as fans
is way stronger than this!

My cheer will go over the goal line
and will be heard for a million miles!{be01}

Come on! Cheer louder!
Yell! Yell!
